stage0059_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$墨田$$
「$$赤木$$!
　I gave $$ダイ・ガード$$ a full overhaul for you.」

stage0059_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$百目鬼$$
「What's this... For someone whose only
　strength is spirit, $$赤木$$, that's weak.」

stage0059_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$柿小路$$
「Sounds like Dr. $$桃井$$ got the better of you.」

stage0059_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$柿小路$$
「Of course I'd know that!
　Honestly, you two rush in without even
　checking if it's true or not...!」

stage0059_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$厚井$$
「Director, if you get too worked up,
　your stomach'll act up again.」

stage0059_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$柿小路$$
「It's fine!
　Both Trider and I got a thorough tune-up.」

stage0059_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「And that's boosted Trider's output too!」

stage0059_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$厚井$$
「That's right, sir.
　We replaced some of the worn-out armor
　with 《$$ガバールニウム$$》.」

stage0059_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Isn't that the alloy in Trider's body?」

stage0059_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$厚井$$
「We're running low on stock of that,
　so some parts now use different armor.」

stage0059_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$セイミー$$
「Put another way, if we armored it all in
　$$ガバールニウム$$, Trider would regain its
　design specs and could do even more.」

stage0059_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$厚井$$
「Though with $$ガバールニウム$$ unavailable
　right now, that's simply not possible.」

stage0059_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't worry, Managing Director,
　Ms. $$セイミー$$. Trider and I won't lose
　to $$バアル$$ or anything else!」

stage0059_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$いぶき$$
「First, we intercept the Mechanical Beast
　Army. Odaiba's full of summer tourists,
　and evacuation isn't done yet.」

stage0059_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$赤木$$
「I'm sorry. I didn't think about your
　feelings and just did as I pleased...」

stage0059_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$いぶき$$
「...You and my dad are a lot alike, $$赤木$$...」

stage0059_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$青山$$
「Later, $$赤木$$!
　The usual Headless Count is here!」

stage0059_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「I've been waiting, $$兜甲児$$ and $c!
　This Odaiba will be your graveyard!」

stage0059_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ボス$$
「What's with that guy!
　You mean he was actually behaving while
　we were off in space!?」

stage0059_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$アスカ$$
「How exactly do you look at that
　$$デュラハン$$ and think he's honorable!?」

stage0059_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$アスカ$$'s right!
　He's just a guy who'd drag Odaiba into a fight!」

stage0059_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$甲児$$
「Come on, $$ブロッケン$$!
　If you want a fight, I'll take you on!」

stage0059_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$n
「And I'll hand you your usual defeat.」

stage0059_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$木下$$
「What's wrong, Director?
　Is your stomachache back?」

stage0059_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$柿小路$$
「No... it's just... while $$ブロッケン伯爵$$
　was giving his same old speech,
　I was doing the math in my head...」

stage0059_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$柿小路$$
「With this Trider refit,
　we're looking at a bigger deficit than expected.」

stage0059_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Well then, Director $$柿小路$$...
　Just for this battle, I'll ask Director
　$$大塚$$ to pay by commission per kill.」

stage0059_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「A samurai keeps his pride even on an
　empty stomach... but you're salarymen.」

stage0059_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$木下$$
「Commission pay? Now I'm fired up!」

stage0059_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$柿小路$$
「That's right, $$木下$$!
　As Team Takeo General Company, let's aim
　to earn over 30,000 in funds!」

stage0059_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Got it, Director!
　Our company's coffers, and the peace of
　Earth and Odaiba, we'll protect it all!!」

stage0059_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Nuoooh!
　You think this is enough to beat me!?」

stage0059_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$甲児$$
「Give it up already, $$ブロッケン$$!」

stage0059_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Silence!
　That is my greatest weapon!」

stage0059_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$田中司令$$
「This is bad...!
　The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s forces have come!」

stage0059_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「Looks like you're struggling, $$ブロッケン伯爵$$.」

stage0059_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Mind your own business!
　You insolent fool, not even naming yourself!」

stage0059_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「I am Demon General $$ダンカン$$.
　Loyal servant of the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$,
　and right hand of Prince $$グーラ$$.」

stage0059_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「So you knew that name after all.」

stage0059_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「This unit is a gift to you from the
　$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$. Use it well.」

stage0059_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「Don't rush, $$金田正太郎$$.
　If you want to fight me, survive this first.」

stage0059_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「Prince $$グーラ$$ wishes it as well.」

stage0059_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$タケル$$
「The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ allies with the Beast Army!?」

stage0059_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Tch!
　Villains getting all buddy-buddy, huh!」

stage0059_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Nguuh...!
　I won't be looked down on by a newcomer!
　Very well, I'll show you my true power!」

stage0059_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Ha ha ha ha!
　You fools, giddy just because it's summer!
　I'll make it even hotter with hellfire!」

stage0059_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$シモン$$
「That bastard!
　He's gonna torch the whole city!?」

stage0059_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Stop it, you!
　Do you think such lawlessness will be allowed!?」

stage0059_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Ha ha ha ha!
　I have no need of your permission!」

stage0059_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$赤木$$
「That guy!
　I won't let him go any further!」

stage0059_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$青山$$
「$$赤木$$!
　Look right below the flying fortress!」

stage0059_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$桃井$$
「It's okay!
　$c... $$ダイ・ガード$$ will save us!」

stage0059_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「A papier-mache robot, is it!
　No matter how loud you roar, crawling on
　the ground is the best you'll manage!」

stage0059_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$赤木$$
「I'll teach you, $$ブロッケン$$!
　With spirit and guts, anything's possible!」

stage0059_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$百目鬼$$
「Nyohoho!
　Looks like that power boost paid off!」

stage0059_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Ngh!
　I didn't expect a punch from an airborne foe!」

stage0059_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$赤木$$
「See that? This is $$ダイ・ガード$$'s true power!」

stage0059_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$青山$$
「You could also call it my expert output tuning.」

stage0059_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$赤木$$
「Praise my piloting skill too, would you!」

stage0059_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What is going on with that thing!?
　How can it jump that high!?」

stage0059_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$赤木$$
「Told you, didn't I, $$アスカ$$?
　Spirit and guts.」

stage0059_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「And effort and guts too, right!」

stage0059_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$赤木$$
「I can't lose to $$いぶき$$'s dad either.」

stage0059_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$桃井$$
「Thank you, $$いぶき$$.
　Now, everyone... let's get out of here.」

stage0059_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$青山$$
「Risking himself to protect a patient who
　couldn't escape in time, what a great dad.」

stage0059_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$赤木$$
「But he doesn't approve of your job...」

stage0059_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$いぶき$$
「That's a separate matter.
　Now... let's fight to protect Odaiba.」

stage0059_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ミサト$$
「All units, follow $$ダイ・ガード$$!
　We're going on the offensive now!」

stage0059_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Alright! I won't lose to $$赤木$$!」

stage0059_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I'll beat the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s space robos too!」

stage0059_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's the spirit, $$ワッ太$$, $$正太郎$$!」

stage0059_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Alright, everyone...!
　Let's get pumped up again with $$赤木$$!」

stage0059_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Looks like there's no enemy reinforcements for now.」

stage0059_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Thanks to $$２１世紀警備保障$$'s quick
　evacuation guidance, damage was minimal.」

stage0059_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Now, if only $$あしゅら男爵$$ and his lot
　would realize their efforts are futile.」

stage0059_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$いぶき$$
（Dad and the others are safe too, right...）

stage0059_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$桃井$$
「Didn't I tell you?
　$$ダイ・ガード$$ would always protect the city.」

stage0059_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
Citizen
「Is Dr. $$桃井$$ friends with $$ダイ・ガード$$?」

stage0059_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$桃井$$
「That's right.
　My daughter is the one piloting it.」

stage0059_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「We did it, everyone!
　Now we're out of the red!」

stage0059_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$柿小路$$
「Not yet, sir!
　Our coffers being full, and peace on
　Earth, both still have a long way to go!」

stage0059_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I know, Director!
　Let's keep working hard together from now on!」

stage0059_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Grr, remember this!
　I'll repay this debt next time we meet!」

stage0059_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$葵$$
「Throwing out a parting line in all that
　chaos doesn't look very cool.」

stage0059_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$甲児$$
「Guess it ended the usual way, huh.」

stage0059_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ブロッケン$$!
　Get back home and tell $$あしゅら$$,
　it's no use no matter what he tries!」

stage0059_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Silence, $$兜甲児$$!
　I'm not so soft as to just say,
　'oh, all right' and go home!」

stage0059_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$甲児$$
「Is that so!
　Then you're getting kicked out right now!」

stage0059_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Nufufu, $$弓さやか$$!
　I was looking forward to seeing you too!」

stage0059_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Nuhoho!
　I'll have plenty of fun with you and your robot!」

stage0059_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$さやか$$
「I knew you'd say that, you lecherous count!」

stage0059_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$さやか$$
「Enemy of women, $$ブロッケン伯爵$$!
　Venus and I will take you down!」

stage0059_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Yo, $$ブロッケン$$.
　I wanted to see you too.」

stage0059_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$隼人$$
「The three of us are all here now.」

stage0059_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$弁慶$$
「How about we play catch with your head?」

stage0059_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「If it's a fiend I'm up against,
　then I'll become an ogre from hell too!」

stage0059_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That's how it is!
　Get ready for it!!」

stage0059_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$赤木$$
「We'll definitely protect the people
　enjoying their hard-earned summer break!」

stage0059_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Hahaha!
　That meddling will be the death of you!」

stage0059_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$赤木$$
「Meddling, none of my business, whatever!
　$$ダイ・ガード$$ is a super robot that defends peace!」

stage0059_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$赤木$$
「Here I come, headless count!
　I'll show you the power of the upgraded $$ダイ・ガード$$!」

stage0059_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「So you've come, elementary school prez!
　Have you finished your summer homework yet?!」

stage0059_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「W-when you put it that way...」

stage0059_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$厚井$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$, $$かなめ$$, and all of us
　are with you, president!」

stage0059_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$木下$$
「If Trider's shot down, we take a massive loss!」

stage0059_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$柿小路$$
「Stay strong, president!
　The homework, and the fight, still lie ahead!」

stage0059_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Got it, everyone!
　I won't lose to $$ブロッケン$$, $$バアル$$,
　or my homework!」

stage0059_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「While I'm at it!
　There's no wa-a-ay I'll lose to debt or hard times!!」

stage0059_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$正太郎$$
（$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s army is invading Earth now...）

stage0059_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$正太郎$$
（$$グーラ$$... so I really do have to fight you...）

stage0059_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$n
「Still playing dirty as always, $$ブロッケン伯爵$$!」

stage0059_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Say whatever you like!
　I'll rise from the depths of hell again and again,
　and plunge this world into terror!」

stage0059_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$n
「Wanting to die again and again,
　you really must be a masochist.」

stage0059_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Eh... that's not what I meant...」

stage0059_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$n
「I'll grant that request...!
　This time, I'll skewer you!」

stage0059_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「W-wait a moment, you!
　That was just a slip of the tongue!」

stage0059_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Nuoh!
　What a gigantic robot!」

stage0059_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Looks like you're surprised.
　This is my $$ガンバスター$$.」

stage0059_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Nufufu... beneath that mighty body,
　what kind of girl with a mighty body is in there?」

stage0059_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Nuhoho!
　I'll strip that armor off and have my fun with you!」

stage0059_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I will never forgive you!
　An indecent enemy like you, I'll crush
　under $$ガンバスター$$!!」

stage0059_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ノリコ$$
（Earth, after so long...
　our homeland...）

stage0059_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ノリコ$$
（Big Sis...
　even if this Earth is a different world,
　$$ノリコ$$ will fight with all her might!）

stage0059_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What's wrong?
　Making a face like that mid-battle...!」
